ValidationRule.description: Once Opportunity is entered and reaches stage 5 or above ,TCV/CTM should not be updated by user. #14571:User can update TCV if Amount < 25000 #21305-for all profiles #2065:Added bypass logic to edit TCV and CTM in late stages
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity')) ),
OR(ISCHANGED(Contract_Term_months__c), ISCHANGED( Total_Contract_Value_TCV__c )),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost')),
NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validations), NOT( $Permission.Edit_TCV_Contract_Terms_in_Late_Stage_Opp ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Total Contract Value (TCV) Or Contract Term (months) once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
